scientific_role: Pre-graph-WB method-development restart of provider reconstruction after observing instability of the V2 local N=25 compatibility gate. This V3 is not claimed prospective relative to V2 local reconstruction outcomes.

reused_frozen_inputs.provider_domain_note: The V2 final public-I1-derived provider domains are frozen as the V3 search domains before any graph prediction. No V3 domain adaptation is allowed.

candidate_reconstruction.search_evidence: Each fit uses its own fresh disjoint N=15 local simulation bank from config_phase5_seed_registry_v3.json.
candidate_reconstruction.candidate_from_each_fit: minimum search-MSE trial within that fit, deterministic candidate-ID tie break
candidate_reconstruction.common_rescore: All seven fit winners are re-evaluated on the same fresh N=100 bank before any method-specific selection.
candidate_reconstruction.common_replay: All seven candidates are replayed on a second fresh N=100 bank after method identities/weights are frozen. Replay is diagnostic only and cannot change selection or weights.

behavioral_centrality.surface: candidate predicted public-I1 sigma vector over the complete public I1 surface with H>0 on the common N=100 rescore bank
behavioral_centrality.centroid: pointwise arithmetic mean of the seven candidate sigma vectors
behavioral_centrality.distance: mean squared distance between candidate sigma vector and the seven-candidate centroid
behavioral_centrality.ranking: ascending centroid distance; tie break by lower N=100 rescore RMSE to public I1, then candidate_id

M2.failure_semantics: NOT_INSTANTIABLE only for technical/incomplete reconstruction, not because an arbitrary RMSE threshold was missed.

M3.discrepancy: Jeffreys-smoothed Bernoulli KL averaged over complete public I1 surface with H>0 using the common N=100 rescore evidence
M3.prior_mass: equal 1/7 within each provider before likelihood weighting

graph_support.rule: rank all 7^3 joint models by descending product weight and retain fixed ranks 1..14
graph_support.allocation: same frozen integer minimax variance-bound allocation as Phase-5 V2

M0.note: M0 has no provider reconstruction but its graph predictions are rerun in the V3 prediction namespace for a common blind-prediction freeze.

execution_gate: The registered V3 reconstruction smoke must pass before any V3 scientific reconstruction is executed.
